caption: Five guest VMs, each configured with 2 vCPU and 8 GB, share one 16-core, 64 GB host through the hypervisor, which hands out 10 vCPU and 40 GB as limits and leaves 6 vCPU and 24 GB unallocated. Those limits are not reserved cores: the VMs average only 2 cores of work, 12.5% of the host.

spec.aria: A stack of five guest VMs, each configured with 2 vCPU and 8 GB, sits on a hypervisor, which on a physical host of 16 cores and 64 GB allocates 10 vCPU and 40 GB and leaves 6 vCPU and 24 GB free.
